# Unicode anchors

## Café and 東京を案内

This section uses [the café guide](#café-and-東京を案内) and records names such as Łódź, Ελληνικά, हिन्दी, and 日本語 without normalizing their spelling. A formatter may adjust safe Markdown style while retaining the exact Unicode text, heading sequence, link destination, and punctuation. The expected document treats these labels as author supplied content, not generated placeholders.

A second paragraph puts the multilingual terms next to inline code `東京` and a literal escaped parenthesis \(sample\), making byte ranges cross both non-ASCII text and escaped punctuation.
